flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: gaa.ie serves a client-side app: the captured page carries no fixture list, so GAA club and county matches are listed from OLBG only and cannot be priced from an official table.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: The Greyhound Board of Great Britain results API returns completed races; no forward racecard with traps, going and runners was retrievable, so no greyhound line is originated.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: ICC publishes team rankings on a client-rendered page and no machine-readable fixture list; domestic boards (Cricket Australia, NZC, ECB, BCCI) likewise serve app shells. Fixtures appear from OLBG only.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: rlwc2026.com and nrl.com return app shells with no fixture JSON; no league table was retrievable to build a strength input from.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: unitedrugby.com and premiershiprugby.com return client-rendered match centres (5.7 KB shell); no table or fixture array was captured, so URC and Premiership fixtures stay unpriced.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: pdc.tv returns the same 1.24 MB JavaScript shell for every route, so the draw is not machine-readable. The PDC participant API gives Order of Merit rankings but not tonight's pairings, so no line is made from ranking alone.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: EHF Champions League and the German/Spanish/French leagues render fixtures client-side; the Danish Herreligaen table is machine-readable but no OLBG-listed fixture in the window involved two Danish sides, so the handball rows stay unpriced.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: Italian SuperLega, Polish PlusLiga and Czech Extraliga tables were captured, but the Italian season is one match old and the Polish table could not be reconciled to a single fixture in the window, so only rows with a reliable sample are priced.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: Golf is an outright tournament market, not a two-sided match. OLBG closes its golf tip markets when round one starts, so in-play weeks show no OLBG listing; the outright shown comes from the PGA Tour leaderboard only.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: Formula 1 and MotoGP publish a round-by-round calendar but not a machine-readable outright market; the race outright is derived from the official drivers' championship only.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: The WTA API returns match objects; where an official singles ranking is missing for either player the row is left unpriced rather than guessed.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: NBA.com and the NBA CDN return HTTP 403 to this capture, so only EuroLeague and EuroCup fixtures are priced from official data.

flags.issue: official source does not publish a machine-readable fixture list
flags.detail: snooker.org carries the draw and WST publishes rankings, but the Northern Ireland Open was in play at capture, so only matches with both players ranked are priced.
